test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Vihaan is twice as efficient as Mayur and can finish a piece of work in 14 days less than Mayur. In how many days Mayur can finish this work?
solution: Given: Vihaan is twice as good as a workman as Mayur Can finish a piece of work in 14 days less than Mayur Concept used: Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken) Efficiency = work done in a single day
